decisions.reason: The source refines only the Hero V silhouette and right arm. The deferred E and L construction requirements remain valid unchanged.
The accent's requirement to derive from and correspond to the Hero V geometry remains valid; its state does not encode the superseded Hero V proportions or option.
The closing V must still be engineered from the Hero V's shared geometry. The source changes that geometry but does not alter or invalidate the candidate's construction relationship.
The source uses aspiration to explain the right-arm extension but does not change the deferred champagne finish, its material role, or its application constraint.
The Hero V geometry refinement does not change the deferred requirement for the complete wordmark to read as one cohesive mark.
The source concerns Hero V geometry and has no effect on accepted review-image formats or file accessibility.
